tree.name: Fallstudie
tree.description: Case-study Project: Definition (types + constants) and empty Implementation. Parallel to BOM Testprojekt — not a model sign-off.

children.name: Definition
children.description: Type catalog and constant folders for the case study.

children.name: Aggregate
children.description: Fuss aggregate operations (Q57). Op is chosen on each Fuss field slot; type stays the column value type.

children.name: Knoten
children.description: General assignable node type (project roots and ordinary nodes).

children.name: Präfixe
children.description: SI prefixes. multiplikator = scale vs the unit’s prefix root (Q51).

children.name: m
children.description: SI prefix milli (10⁻³); with Meter → mm.

children.name: Milli
children.description: SI prefix milli (10⁻³); with Meter → mm.

children.name: Mega
children.description: SI prefix mega (10⁶); name Mega avoids slug clash with milli m.

children.name: Basiseinheiten
children.description: Base units (catalog). Short description = symbol / Kuerzel.

children.name: Kilogramm
children.description: SI base kg; prefixes attach to gram (mg/kg/Mg).

children.name: Bauformen
children.description: Package / footprint constants (axial, radial, SMD sizes).

children.name: Durchloch Axial
children.description: Leads left/right of body (e.g. resistors, older capacitors).

children.name: Durchloch Radial
children.description: Both leads on one side (e.g. many capacitors).

children.name: display_node_name
children.description: Read-only: shows the host Node.name (no user input).

children.name: media
children.description: WP Media Library and/or URL (Q65). MIME-based display.

children.name: list
children.description: Collection with exactly one column; rows open.

children.name: table
children.description: Collection with n columns; rows open.

children.name: enum
children.description: Like list + closed options under the column.

children.name: Bauart
children.description: Concrete enum for footprints / package styles (0201, 0603, axial, …).

children.name: set
children.description: Collection of named members; schema = child nodes.

children.name: node_pick
children.description: Shared parent (Q73): ref_scope + allowed catalog children.

children.name: node_embed
children.description: Pick under catalog root; embed target fields.

children.name: node_ref
children.description: Pick under catalog root; store id only.

children.name: Relationstypen
children.description: RelationType catalog (Q35/Q54/Q74). Additive types such as composition are chosen here.

children.name: besteht_aus
children.description: Domain composition / besteht aus (Q75/Q85 set members).

children.name: child_of
children.description: Hierarchy Kind von (system). Not creatable via Add relation — use Reparent.

children.name: has_type
children.description: Data-type binding (has_type). Managed via Relations UI; persists as type_id (Q74).

children.name: Relationstypen
children.description: RelationType catalog (Q35/Q54/Q74). Additive types such as composition are chosen here.

children.name: aggregation
children.description: Aggregation — member lives on when the host object no longer exists (attribute Bindung).

children.name: besteht_aus
children.description: Composition / besteht aus — dies with the object (Q75/Q85; attribute Bindung).

children.name: child_of
children.description: Hierarchy Kind von (system). Multiplicity always 1 (exactly one parent). Not creatable via Add relation — use Reparent.

children.name: has_type
children.description: Data-type binding (has_type). Managed via Relations UI; persists as type_id (Q74).

children.name: Model
children.description: Example schema hosts for Form/Table preview (Kontakt, Platine, …).

children.name: Bauteil
children.description: Ist eine Komponente zum Platinenbau und erfüllte eine bestimme elektrische funtkionaltität

children.name: Kontakt
children.description: Contact person schema: Name + E-Mail attributes.

children.name: Platine
children.description: PCB / board schema: Name attribute (preview sample Prototype PCB).

children.name: Trash
children.description: Soft-deleted nodes. Empty to permanently remove.
